tagline: High-Retention Video Editing & Commercial Color Finishing
heroStatement: I transform raw footage into engaging visual stories designed to capture attention and elevate your brand.
editorialStatement: I DON'T JUST EDIT VIDEOS. I BUILD ATTENTION.
editorialParagraph: Every cut, transition, sound effect and frame has a purpose. I focus on creating videos that feel polished, engaging and visually memorable — from high-retention short-form edits and UGC to commercial brand films and cinematic edits.
brandStatement: RAW FOOTAGE IS ONLY THE BEGINNING.
brandSubtext: The right edit can change how a story feels, how long someone watches, and what they remember.
bio: I'm Harsh, a freelance video editor focused on creating engaging digital content for creators, brands and businesses.
I enjoy taking raw footage and turning it into content that feels polished, intentional and worth watching.
Whether you need a high-retention Reel, Trading Videos, a YouTube video, a Documentary Style , or a cinematic edit, I'm available to collaborate.

projects.title: Trading Editing
projects.shortDescription: High-impact Trading edit featuring dynamic cuts, DaVinci color grading, and spatial audio sync.
projects.fullDescription: A premier Trading edit highlighting brand aesthetic, product details, and rhythmic pacing. Streamed in full 4K quality.
projects.challenge: Balancing fast visual rhythm while preserving an elegant brand narrative arc.
projects.solution: Synchronized visual cuts to subtle audio transients and created custom split-tone grading.

projects.title: Short-Form Retention Edit
projects.shortDescription: Fast-paced, hook-optimized vertical edit built for maximum viewer retention on Instagram Reels and TikTok.
projects.fullDescription: An energetic short-form edit engineered to keep audiences glued from the opening hook to the end screen with pattern interrupts, animated text, and sound effects.
projects.challenge: Squeezing maximum narrative density and visual flair into under 45 seconds.
projects.solution: Utilized kinetic typography, speed ramping, and micro-sound accents.

projects.title: DOCUMENTARY EDITING
projects.fullDescription: Cinematic documentary edits built around storytelling, emotion, and atmosphere. From crime documentaries and real-life stories to investigative films, every frame is crafted to create a powerful viewing experience.
projects.challenge: Producing an ad creative that looks native to social feeds while maintaining strong sales conversion hooks.
projects.solution: Structured the first 3 seconds around a pattern-interrupt problem statement followed by fast-paced feature highlights.

projects.title: Coaches & Personal Brands
projects.fullDescription: High-quality video editing for coaches, mentors, educators, and personal brands. Transform your knowledge into engaging content through clean editing, storytelling, dynamic visuals, and professional motion graphics.
projects.challenge: Filtering vast footage into an emotional visual piece with cinematic shadow roll-off.
